title: Reorder from your suppliers on Taskiem
summary: Every morning, what is low is ordered from your linked suppliers at the prices on their lists, after one approval.
description: Every day at the time you choose, Taskiem looks at your low items linked to a supplier's price list on Taskiem and puts together one order per supplier, for enough to reach each item's order-up-to level, at their listed prices. You approve the orders once; each then reaches the supplier as an order in their own Taskiem. An order above your approval limit is left drafted for a second person to send. Low items no linked supplier lists are named, so you can link them on the Prices page. Nothing is ordered twice: an item already on an open order is left out.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the orders are put together, Lagos time.

params.name: approver_role
params.title: Who approves
params.description: The role that approves the orders.

definition.name: Reorder from linked suppliers
definition.description: Orders what is low from linked suppliers at their listed prices, after one approval.

steps.name: Find what to order from each supplier

subject.orders: =steps.low.output.orders.map(o, o.business + ': ' + o.items.map(i, string(int(i.quantity)) + ' ' + i.name).join(', ') + ', NGN ' + string(double(o.total_kobo) / 100.0)).join('; ')

steps.name: Tell the owner what was ordered

input.message: ='Ordered: ' + steps.send.output.filter(o, !has(o.not_sent)).map(o, o.order.reference + ' from ' + o.order.business + (o.order.status == 'drafted' ? ' (waiting for a second person to send it)' : '')).join(', ') + (size(steps.send.output.filter(o, has(o.not_sent))) > 0 ? '. Not ordered: ' + steps.send.output.filter(o, has(o.not_sent)).map(o, o.not_sent.business + ' (' + o.not_sent.reason + ')').join(', ') : '')
